For `xcsh_workload`, the setting is:

```text
stateful_service.advertise_options.advertise_on_public.multi_ports.ports.http_loadbalancer.https_auto_cert.server_name
```

- Optional string; sets the `Server` response-header value, **overwriting existing values**.
- Provider-enforced maximum length: **8096 characters**.
- Mutually exclusive with `append_server_name`, `default_header`, and `pass_through`.

Verified in bundled provider **v12.4.0**: [exact field reference](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/workload/properties/stateful_service/advertise_options/advertise_on_public/multi_ports/ports/http_loadbalancer/https_auto_cert/index.md#schema-stateful_service--advertise_options--advertise_on_public--multi_ports--ports--http_loadbalancer--https_auto_cert--server_name).

Use **`append_server_name`** in resource **`xcsh_workload`**:

```text
stateful_service.advertise_options.advertise_on_public.multi_ports.ports.http_loadbalancer.https_auto_cert.append_server_name
```

It sets the `Server` response-header value **only when absent**, preserving existing values unchanged.

- Optional string; provider-enforced maximum: **8,096 characters**.
- Mutually exclusive with `default_header`, `pass_through`, and `server_name`.
- Do **not** use `server_name`: it overwrites existing values.

Verified in bundled provider **v12.4.0**: [exact field reference](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/workload/properties/stateful_service/advertise_options/advertise_on_public/multi_ports/ports/http_loadbalancer/https_auto_cert/index.md?view=full#schema-stateful_service--advertise_options--advertise_on_public--multi_ports--ports--http_loadbalancer--https_auto_cert--append_server_name).

Use **`server_name`** in resource **`xcsh_workload`**:

```text
stateful_service.advertise_options.advertise_on_public.multi_ports.ports.http_loadbalancer.https_auto_cert.server_name
```

It sets the `Server` response-header value and **overwrites any existing value**. Unlike `append_server_name`, it does not preserve the existing header.

Optional string; provider-enforced maximum: **8,096 characters**. Mutually exclusive with `append_server_name`, `default_header`, and `pass_through`.

Verified in bundled provider **v12.4.0**: [exact field reference](xcsh://terraform-documentation/documentation/resources/workload/properties/stateful_service/advertise_options/advertise_on_public/multi_ports/ports/http_loadbalancer/https_auto_cert/index.md?view=full#schema-stateful_service--advertise_options--advertise_on_public--multi_ports--ports--http_loadbalancer--https_auto_cert--server_name).
